title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A zero that had not been earned
summary: Nothing in the extension changed. The witness that checks what the per file sweep cuts stayed at zero even when the cut was shifted by one character.

highlights.title: The sweep witness now catches an offset shift
highlights.description: Shift a cut by one character and all six counters stayed silent: the name is still inside, the braces still balance, the indentation does not move. It was missing the whole line rule the four other witnesses have. The same shift now reports nineteen violations.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The witness for the per file sweep checks that a deletion takes whole lines, for the family that cuts whole lines and that family only.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Every test added since 1.42.232 was run against the code from before its fix. Sixteen fail there, which is what a test for a fix is supposed to do, and none of the batch passes for a wrong reason.
